posts.author: Acknuth
posts.body:
Mononc'Adventures has been available since August 30, 2024, and the journey is far from over!
With all the updates so far, we're up to 45 hours of gameplay!
I'll admit it—I have a lot of fun writing these stories.
With dark humor and sarcasm, Mononc and his friends explore a vast archipelago full of challenges and adventures. Behind every door could be a trial, a random anecdote, or a hidden treasure...
In my French-speaking region, "Mononc" is the diminutive of "my Uncle". Here, Mononc and his friends, treasure hunters, adventurers a little wacky, always looking for glories and hidden treasures are constantly involved in unusual and bizarre situations.
A main quest of around 15 hours, plus six optional side quests of about 4 hours each, treasure hunts, and of course, those moments when Mononc and his pals get into trouble after visiting places they probably shouldn’t have (I’ve hidden plenty of surprises for the curious ones who like to wander off the beaten path).
Dialogues adapt based on which characters you’ve recruited. Technically, the game can be completed solo with just Mononc, but seven recruitable friends are scattered across the archipelago. Each one brings their own set of skills, interactions, and surprise missions that can pop up at any time.
I have used the best resources available here, and if this project finds its public, many more updates will follow, bringing new adventures and encouraging those who develop resources for the community.
Each island in the archipelago has its own environment and challenges.
Many buildings are open to be visited, sometimes containing surprises like hidden side quests.
A wide variety of environments to explore.
Escape is only possible during random encounters. Combat initiated by contact with an enemy cannot be escaped.
The game is available on Steam for 9.99 USD$

posts.author: Acknuth
posts.body:
Kevinthedork said:
Luv Sacarcastic Humor
Click to expand...
Nothing here takes itself seriously — it's all meant for laughs!
All the characters are caricatures inspired by the weirdest people I've met. Psychologically speaking, we pretty much make fun of everyone: Psycho, a typical douchebag dreaming of the day he'll finally save a princess, Antosh, the thief who's afraid of the dark, Black Kali, the slightly freaky metalhead (also inspired by the Hindu goddess of destruction and by my cat).... All wrapped up in a lighthearted tone.
Drugs are replaced by a variety of glasses of milk (yes, there’s real rum too!), but most of the punchlines are crafted so that only adults will really get them.
That’s probably why I don’t have an ESRB rating.
